id: title:Gilbert09:stop rate limit retries reporting error tracking noise

review.posthog_relevance: Adds recovery capability for Notion data ingestion by treating 429 rate limits and 5xx errors as retryable, preserving self-recovery behavior established by the tenacity library.
review.reason: Adds a specific, bounded reliability improvement: treating 'Notion rate limited' and 'Notion API error (retryable)' as retryable exceptions. This prevents transient failures from becoming permanent errors, supporting the Notion warehouse ingestion workflow.
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and recovery success are not demonstrated; this is a configuration change dependent on the underlying tenacity library and Notion API behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are both supplied and complete, so no abstention is required. No other hunks exist in this chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds 'Notion rate limited' to the set of retryable errors, while retaining 'Notion API error (retryable)'. The comment is updated to acknowledge 429s and the tenacity library's handling of Retry-After headers.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Temporal worker to retry the Notion data import activity when the failure is due to a 429 rate limit or a 5xx server error, rather than treating it as a terminal, unclassified exception.
